rows.minimum_evidence_pattern: Capacity below policy threshold OR complete monitored capacity shows no large allocation, no sustained GPU/power load, no synchronized fabric, no training semantics, and high integrity coverage.
rows.missing_data_handling: If any critical layer is missing, do not label 0 solely from absence; downgrade to 1 or mark unknown/low confidence.
rows.notes: For real audits, this is a negative-certification claim and should use bottleneck/minimum logic.
rows.suggested_rule_for_synthetic_ground_trut: Assign 0 only if capacity_possible=false OR all primary activity scores <=1 and coverage_strong=true across critical layers.

rows.minimum_evidence_pattern: Capacity exists or weak/small activity exists, but primary activity does not cross material thresholds.
rows.missing_data_handling: Missing primary layers usually cap no-run confidence and keep the window at possible unless other evidence raises it.
rows.notes: Base-capacity fields feed this label only.
rows.suggested_rule_for_synthetic_ground_trut: Assign 1 when capacity_possible=true and no primary activity signal exceeds possible/elevated thresholds, or when evidence is too sparse for no-run.

rows.minimum_evidence_pattern: One primary layer is materially elevated, or a supportive layer is elevated while activity coverage is incomplete.
rows.missing_data_handling: Missingness is not positive by itself; it becomes elevated only when aligned with high power, allocation, capacity changes, or tamper indicators.
rows.notes: This is the normal alert/cross-check tier.
rows.suggested_rule_for_synthetic_ground_trut: Assign 2 if any O2/O3/O4/O5/O6/O7 signal scores 2, or if high power/storage anomalies coincide with missing activity telemetry.

rows.minimum_evidence_pattern: Sustained large allocation/provisioning OR scale-out fabric collective footprint, plus high GPU/power activity, plus at least one semantic/supportive signal.
rows.missing_data_handling: If integrity coverage is poor, keep as 2-3 with an integrity warning rather than 'definite'.
rows.notes: HPC/batch inference can still be false positives; use runtime/storage/logs to disambiguate.
rows.suggested_rule_for_synthetic_ground_trut: Assign 3 when two independent primary activity layers score >=3 for the same window, or one primary >=3 plus one semantic/supportive >=2 and integrity coverage is adequate.

rows.minimum_evidence_pattern: Authenticated ML logs/declarations/runtime metadata show policy-scale training, OR scheduler + fabric + GPU + power + storage all cohere under high integrity.
rows.missing_data_handling: If key semantic data is missing but activity evidence is overwhelming, label as 'highest warning' rather than literal definite until inspection.
rows.notes: This tier should trigger protected raw-record review, not public disclosure.
rows.suggested_rule_for_synthetic_ground_trut: Assign 4 when O12 semantic evidence scores 4 and compute threshold is crossed, OR at least three independent activity/supportive layers score >=3 including fabric/scheduler and integrity coverage >0.95.

rows.minimum_evidence_pattern: Telemetry gaps, invalid attestation, collector changes, or physical/firmware anomalies overlap candidate activity.
rows.missing_data_handling: Model should learn missingness/coverage vectors separately from activity values.
rows.notes: Integrity anomalies are especially important when power is high but GPU/fabric telemetry is low.
rows.suggested_rule_for_synthetic_ground_trut: Apply an integrity flag and reduce negative-certification confidence; do not automatically raise training label unless physical/activity signals also rise.

rows.minimum_evidence_pattern: Normalized accelerator capacity, topology, and power/cooling envelope are below threshold.
rows.missing_data_handling: If capacity data is missing, do not assume impossibility.
rows.suggested_rule_for_synthetic_ground_trut: Cap positive training labels near 0/1 unless there is evidence of off-ledger capacity or unmonitored subclusters.
